title: The Human Mirror
logline: After her meddling sends Wendy's boyfriend and cat to Phoenix, Lily vows a month without meddling and Marshall bets his beloved Bigfoot sweatshirt she can't. Then Ted falls for Juniper, a copy editor who instantly loves whatever the person in front of her loves, and only Lily can see it.

couch.line: Dad, Aunt Lily signed me up for ballroom dancing so I'd meet someone.
He's the only boy. They had to put him on a schedule.
Nobody can make your Aunt Lily stop. But once, in the spring of 2009, she tried to stop herself.
That depends on how you define meddling. Your Aunt Lily defined it very, very narrowly.

guests.name: Juniper Pell
guests.role: Ted's new girlfriend, a sunny freelance copy editor who instantly adopts the favorite thing of whoever she's talking to (scotch with Robin, suits with Barney, Bigfoot with Marshall) without noticing she does it, because nobody has ever asked her what she likes.

facts.lily.meddling_vow: kept a 30-day no-meddling vow; Marshall ruled she won
facts.marshall.bigfoot_sweatshirt: brown 'I Believe' sweatshirt; Lily won the bet but now wears it
facts.ted.dating: single; ended it kindly with Juniper Pell, who mirrored everyone
facts.wendy.ex: Gary, now in Phoenix with her Persian cat, Mister Pickles

opens.note: Lily keeps a binder of women to set Ted up with, started on day two of her vow. Ted has asked for it. This is volume one.
Wendy and Juniper are driving to Phoenix to steal back Mister Pickles from Gary

scenes.summary: Wendy confronts Lily: her meddling sent Gary, and the cat, to Phoenix. Lily vows a month of no meddling; Marshall bets his Bigfoot sweatshirt. Ted walks in having met someone perfect.

beats.line: You told Gary I was ready to get married.
You are ready! You have a wedding binder with color-coded tabs!
Gary found the binder. Gary moved to Phoenix.
And he took Mister Pickles. Mister Pickles is a Persian. In Phoenix.
Lilypad, that's three this year. The dentist, your cousin's wedding, and now a cat.
The dentist and I are still close!
He sends you a blank Christmas card. Every year. Just blank.
Fine. One month. No meddling. Not a nudge, not a hint, not a wink.
Lily, you set up two pigeons on the walk over here.
And they're very happy.
Baby, you won't last a week. If you crack, you wear my Bigfoot sweatshirt. To parent-teacher conferences.
The one that says I Believe?
In letters you can read from the parking lot.
Deal. And when I win, we burn it.
Lily, it's a hundred percent polyester. It'll take the whole block.
Guys. I met someone. She's perfect.
That's wonderful, Ted. I have no thoughts about it at all.

scenes.label: Day 4
scenes.summary: Ted introduces Juniper. She instantly loves scotch for Robin, suits for Barney, Bigfoot for Marshall. Lily asks her least favorite food and gets her own question back.

beats.line: Everyone, this is Juniper. She's a copy editor. She corrects other people's grammar for money.
So she's you, with a business model.
Ted explained the Chrysler Building's spire to me for two hours. Best night of my life.
She let me finish. Nobody lets me finish.
You a scotch person?
Neat. Never on ice. Ice is for hockey.
Marry her.
Juniper. Where do we stand on suits?
A suit is just a tuxedo being humble.
Ted, if you don't marry her, I will. In a humble tuxedo.
Juniper. Quick one. Bigfoot.
Twice. Oregon. He waved.
Lily. She's been waved at.
Juniper, what's your least favorite food?
What's yours?
Raisins.
Ugh. Raisins.

scenes.summary: Later. Lily names it: a human mirror. Everyone else is too flattered to see it. She goes to tell Ted; Marshall stops her with two words.

beats.line: She's a mirror. You're all in love with a human mirror.
Lily, she's seen Bigfoot.
She's seen whatever you've seen!
Which is Bigfoot.
My kindergartners do this. Whatever my favorite color is, that's their favorite color. That's not chemistry. They want a sticker.
Or she agrees with everybody because she's right about everything.
She laughed at my laser tag story in all the right places.
There are no right places.
She found some!
That's it. I'm telling Ted.
I believe.
Twenty-six more days.

scenes.summary: Day nine. Marshall, breaking in the Bigfoot sweatshirt, rules on Lily's loopholes. Her coded mirror metaphor sends Ted into a lecture on Versailles. She asks what counts if somebody else does it.

beats.line: By day nine, your Aunt Lily had stopped meddling and started litigating.
Is it meddling to say something true about mirrors? In general. To nobody.
Mirrors. Generally. To nobody.
Allowed.
Why are you wearing that?
Breaking it in for you. Bigfoot fur takes a while to soften.
Ted. Isn't it funny how a mirror can't really love you? It only ever shows you you.
Lily, mirrors are fascinating! The Hall of Mirrors at Versailles was basically Louis the Fourteenth saying—
Never mind.
Juniper loves Versailles. She's taking me to a doorknob exhibit tonight. Her idea!
Was it?
She had it right after I talked about doorknobs for an hour.
Counselor. Is it meddling if somebody else does it?
I'd have to see the somebody.

scenes.label: Day 12
scenes.summary: Lily hires Wendy, who still hasn't forgiven her, to hand Juniper a terrible opinion. Marshall catches the payment; Wendy sells Lily out.

beats.line: Wendy. I need a favor.
So did Mister Pickles.
Ted's dating a woman with no opinions. Hand her a terrible one and see if she takes it.
Why me?
You're a waitress. Nobody sees you. You're basically a wire.
Fifty dollars. And I'll never set you up again.
A hundred. And you call Gary and tell him the binder was yours.
Done.
Proxy meddling!
I'm tipping a waitress, Marshall. I'm a famously big tipper.
She's never tipped me in her life.

scenes.summary: Wendy calls the Chrysler Building tacky. Juniper agrees instantly; Ted decides friction is healthy. Then Juniper bonds with Wendy over Phoenix cats and the wire goes native.

beats.line: Can I just say? The Chrysler Building is tacky.
Thank you! It's a hood ornament with a lobby.
On Saturday you cried at the spire.
I cry at tacky things. I cried at Cats. Twice.
See? We disagree about the Chrysler Building. That's healthy. Couples need friction.
Are you okay? You seem sad.
My boyfriend moved to Phoenix and took my cat.
My cat's in Phoenix too!
Your wire just went native.

scenes.label: Day 23
scenes.summary: Ted is asking Juniper to move in and designing her a closet. Lily barely holds it in. Alone, she tells Marshall why she meddles; Marshall tells her what she'd be skipping for Ted.

beats.line: Tomorrow, at Castellano's, I'm asking Juniper to move in.
Ted. That's a big step.
Too big?
It's a step. Of a size.
I'm designing her a closet. Cedar. Built-ins. A whole shoe wall.
What does she keep in it?
I'll call and ask. She's going to love whatever I say.
Why are you letting this happen?
Why can't you?
Because I'm the one on this couch after. Every time. With the ice cream, and the tissues, and the speech about how it's her loss.
If I can see the cliff, and I just watch him walk off it, what am I?
His friend.
Baby, this couch isn't just where he cries. It's where he figures it out. You don't get to skip that part for him.
And if he doesn't figure it out?
Then you'll be on the couch. You always are.

scenes.label: Day 24
scenes.summary: Castellano's. Lily and Marshall at the next table, Lily in a baseball cap. Ted starts his big question; Lily rises to stop it and Marshall sings her back down. Ted explains the phone call about the closet.

beats.line: Lily, this is a stakeout.
It's a dinner. With proximity.
Juniper, I've been designing something for us.
I love it!
I haven't told you what it is.
I believe.
It's a closet. Cedar. Built-ins. So last night I called to ask what you'd keep in it.
So. Shelves or hooks?
Whatever you like!
Okay. What's your favorite color?
What's yours?
Huh.

scenes.label: Meanwhile
scenes.summary: Robin and Barney handicap the move-in question.

beats.line: Twenty bucks says she says yes before he finishes the question.
She'll say yes before he starts it.
Fifty says she says yes to a question he didn't ask.
No bet.

scenes.summary: Ted figured it out himself. He asks Juniper what she wants; nobody ever has. Pancakes. She goes. Ted knew Lily was there all along.

beats.line: I couldn't design you one shelf. I don't know a single thing you like.
I like whatever you like.
I know. And I liked that a little too much.
Is this a breakup?
Do you want it to be?
Nobody's ever asked me what I want.
So what do you want? Right now. Anything.
Pancakes. Somewhere else.
Then go get pancakes.
You can take off the hat, Lil.

scenes.summary: Later, on the couch, as Marshall promised. Lily admits she knew; Ted explains why he had to see it himself. Lily realizes she never asked Juniper anything either. Six more days.

beats.line: I knew on day four. I almost told you nine times.
I know. You did a whole thing about mirrors.
If you'd told me on day four, I'd have dated her for a year just to prove you wrong.
I thought she was playing you.
She wasn't playing anybody. Nobody ever asked her.
I didn't either. I asked her about raisins. As a trap.
Lil. I know why you do it.
Because I'm nosy.
Because you can't stand watching us get hurt. It's the nicest annoying thing about you.
Can I at least tell you to get a haircut?
Six more days.

scenes.label: Day 30
scenes.summary: Marshall rules: every attempt failed so badly it was just weather. Lily wins; the sweatshirt must burn. Juniper drops by to collect Wendy for a cat heist and delivers her own opinions to everyone, including about Bigfoot.

beats.line: In the matter of Lily Aldrin versus Lily Aldrin's nature.
The defendant bribed a waitress, lectured an architect about mirrors, and attended a breakup in a baseball cap.
Lil, you were four feet away. You sent back my soup.
However, every single attempt failed so badly, the court can't call it meddling. It's just weather.
I won?
You won. Tonight, the sweatshirt burns.
Hi! Just grabbing Wendy. We're driving to Phoenix to steal back Mister Pickles.
I figured out what I like, Ted. Mostly, I like disagreeing with people.
Robin, scotch tastes like a burnt couch.
Barney, a suit is just pajamas for liars.
And Marshall? Bigfoot isn't real.
But Oregon. He waved.
That was a man in a fur coat, hailing a cab.
Lily. Next time, meddle harder.
Burn it, baby. Burn it all.

scenes.label: Day 31
scenes.summary: Past midnight. Lily, who won, is wearing the Bigfoot sweatshirt for Marshall. Ted asks to be set up. She has a binder.

beats.line: Baby, you won. You don't have to wear it.
Somebody in this family has to believe.
So. It's day thirty-one. Hypothetically, if you knew someone for me...
Is that a binder?
I started it on day two.
Color-coded tabs.
This is volume one.
